print('Canonical root:',root.resolve())
for base,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
    dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in ('.git','node_modules')]
    for name in sorted(files):
        p=Path(base)/name
        s=p.lstat()
        print('\\nPATH:',p.relative_to(root),'MODE:',oct(s.st_mode),'MTIME_NS:',s.st_mtime_ns)
        if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode):
            data=p.read_bytes()
            print('SHA256:',hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
            print(data.decode())
        else:
            print('Not a regular file; not followed')
